actions.description:
Requirements The experienced hound is adjacent to a Prone creature

Effect The experienced hound attempts an Athletics check to [[/act grapple]] the prone creature. The experienced hound can then Step away from the target; if the target is Grabbed by the hound, it is moved into the hound's previous square and remains grabbed.
actions.name: Drag
actions.requirements: The experienced hound is adjacent to a Prone creature

actions.description: The experienced hound doesn't take a penalty to make a nonlethal attack with its jaws.
actions.name: Humane Bite

actions.description: The hound's Strikes deal 2d6 extra damage to creatures within the reach of at least two of the hound's allies.
actions.name: Pack Attack

name: Experienced Hound
publicNotes: An experienced hound has been on dozens of hunts. They are often raised from pups to catch the scents of certain animals and deliver their bodies unharmed when taken down by their owners. An experienced hound could accompany a hunter or other NPC who specializes in tracking down prey.
